primary_claim: A source-only, target-label-invariant structural proposal raises heldout feasible-basin coverage in a dimension-equivariant policy coordinate.

online_backend.role: replaceable backend rather than a novelty claim

allowed: policy/state exposure schema without target outcomes
forbidden: target outcomes before the charged target stage
target oracle objective, optimizer, chance margin, or feasibility
terminal verification responses during search or shortlist construction

claim_boundaries.saasbo: standard backend, not claimed as novel
claim_boundaries.orthogonality_sparsity_additivity: hypothesis-class ablations without current coequal causal support
claim_boundaries.cumulative_hvd: risk-calibration contribution pending the registered causal optimization gate

registered_stress_tests: domain-blind proposal without heldout task-family identifier
dimension holdout from d_source to a different d_target

proposal_coverage_theory.bound: L*(source_support_atlas_cover_radius + ideal_coordinate_domain_shift + 2*coordinate_approximation_error) <= target_safe_depth implies the frozen atlas contains a feasible policy
geometric_coverage_inputs: source consensus templates union target-label-free universal structural support
maximin atlas covering radius in the dimension-equivariant coordinate
source-to-target support shift in the ideal transferable coordinate
chance-margin Lipschitz constant in that coordinate
proposal_coverage_theory.empirical_obligation: Measure source support, atlas covering radius, and coordinate approximation error before target observations; audit ideal-coordinate domain shift, safe depth, and a valid Lipschitz upper bound post-run without using them for selection.

necessity_theorem.statement: Every proper finite target-label-free atlas misses some nonempty heldout feasible set; an explicit transfer or structural coverage assumption is unavoidable.

rank_alignment_candidate_rejected_as_hea.reason: source-only finite-sample rank-alignment bound was vacuous in all three d=1000 heldout domains
